description: Push externally-generated rows into a verify-only synthetic run (sourceMode IMPORTED): your pipeline (NeMo Data Designer, Curator, distilabel, in-house) made the rows; OpenTrain runs the trust filters (dedup + benchmark-contamination scan) and vetted human verification (accept/fix/reject), then exports only what passed plus a Quality Certificate. Idempotent per batch by content hash. Requires synthetic:write.

batchSha256.description: Optional content hash for idempotent retries (derived server-side if omitted).

finalize.description: true on (or after) the last batch: runs trust filters + routes to human verification.

generator.description: Your pipeline/tool name for the certificate, e.g. "nemo-data-designer".

records.description: Externally-generated rows (max 200 per call — chunk larger sets).

name: opentrain_synthetic_push_rows
